text: Program Description Academic Year & Curriculum This is a 4-year program, 3 trimesters per academic year. Curriculum (160 Credits) Program Orientation The program aims to enable students to be proficient Chinese language communication, to understand the fundamentals of traditional Chinese medicine and thus to engage in international TCM cooperation and trade service. Main Courses · Intermediate Chinese Listening & Speaking · Intermediate Chinese Reading & Writing · Advanced Chinese · Basic Chinese of Traditional Chinese Medicine · Advanced Business Chinese · General Introduction to Traditional Chinese Medicine · General Introduction to Economics · Guided Reading to International Trade · Overview on Trade of Traditional Chinese Medicine · History of Chinese Medicine · Traditional Chinese Medicine Culture · History of Traditional Chinese Medicine Cultural Communication · An Overview of the Internationalization of Traditional Chinese Medicine Graduation and Academic Degree A Bachelor of Arts will be awarded upon completion of · Required credits of all courses in the teaching scheme (Attachment 1) · Pass of all examinations · New HSK 6≥180
